decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with zero product activity: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no tickets. Only touch is our own welcome email [email:9f412d50] with no customer reply, so there's no signal of intent or a blocker being worked through. 8 days left, but silent accounts rarely self-start.

draft.subject: A hand with your first Wrenfield project
draft.body:
Hi Theo,

Checking in now that your Orchard Labs workspace has been open a week. If you haven't had a chance to dig in yet, no problem at all — the usual first step is creating a first project, since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Nadia
